bundle.longDescription: Manu is an AI-native fiction development environment. A project is a folder of plain files you own; the story's structure — state, knowledge, relationships, chronology, objects, threads and causality — is recorded alongside the manuscript so continuity can be checked, tested, debugged and refactored deterministically.
